entities.summary: Mirza Jabbar Mirza Abbas oghlu Mammadzade was an Azerbaijani educator, pedagogue, doctor of pedagogical sciences, professor (1937). He was a deputy of the first convocation of the Parliament of the Republic of Armenia.
